top_signals.title: Georgia Voters to Decide Fate of $17 Billion Data Center Megaproject
top_signals.summary: Coweta County voters will decide in a Jan. 12 special election whether to repeal the rezoning for Project Sail, a $17 billion data center campus on more than 800 rural acres about 45 miles southwest of Atlanta that county commissioners approved 3-2 in April. Probate Judge Carrie B. Markham ordered the election Monday. Opponents filed their petition Oct. 16 under the Home Rule provision of the Georgia Constitution, which let them force a vote with signatures from 10% of the county's electorate: 10,971 names, out of 109,703 active electors in the…
